what_was_implemented.AIRs: Active residues = any heavy atom <5 Å of partner chain in bound 1BRS; passive residues = same-chain residues within 6.5 Å of an active residue (HADDOCK definition). AIR pseudo-energy uses HADDOCK soft minimum-distance per-residue formulation with target d=2 Å and quadratic flat-bottom penalty.
what_was_implemented.scoring: HS = 1.0·E_vdw + 0.2·E_elec + 0.1·E_AIR + 1.0·E_desolv with weights from van Zundert et al. 2015 (J. Mol. Biol., HADDOCK 2.2). E_vdw is 12-6 LJ with OPLS-like atomic radii, capped to avoid clashes. E_elec is Coulomb with distance-dependent dielectric ε=10·r. E_desolv uses a Fauchère–Plis̆ka residue hydrophobicity scale weighted by interface burial.
what_was_implemented.sampling: 120 random rigid-body orientations of barstar around barnase, AIR-centroid pre-alignment, then ≤35 numerical-gradient steps on (R,t) on the HADDOCK score.
what_was_implemented.clustering: Single-linkage clustering on Cα-based ligand-RMSD with threshold 7.5 Å on the top 60 poses by HADDOCK score.
what_was_implemented.validation: Per-residue contact and energetic descriptors of bound and predicted structures correlated with SKEMPI 2.0 mutation ΔΔG (Spearman/Pearson).

deviations.force_field: Full CHARMM/OPLSx forcefield not used; LJ + simplified charge lookup is a surrogate.
deviations.water_refinement: HADDOCK's it1 SA + explicit-water stages replaced by single AIR-driven gradient minimisation.
deviations.clustering: FCC contact-based clustering replaced by Cα L-RMSD single linkage.
deviations.haddock3_workflow: haddock3 binary not installed; pipeline is a Python re-implementation.

invariants_preserved: AIR-driven docking (information-driven biomolecular modelling, not blind shape complementarity)
Active vs passive residue logic with 5/6.5 Å definitions
AIR effective distance per-residue penalty with target ≈2 Å
